title: VanaM Inc. Is at Nano Korea 2025
body:
🚀 VanaM Inc. is at Nano Korea 2025!
📍 Booth 2K10 | KINTEX, July 2–4

Showcasing our next generation thin films at one of Asia’s leading nanotech exhibitions!

Come visit us at Booth 2K10 to explore how our advanced thin film solutions are enabling breakthroughs in:
🔹 Semiconductor innovation
🔹 Quantum photonics
🔹 Next-gen optoelectronics

Let’s connect, collaborate, and shape the future of nanoscale technology—together.

#VanaMInc #NanoKorea2025 #ThinFilms #QuantumPhotonics #Superconductors #Nanotechnology #KINTEX #AdvancedMaterials

만나고, 협력하고, 나노 스케일 기술의 미래를 함께 만들어가요.
